verdict.rationale: LangGraph's own README and docs point to first-party debugging with LangSmith, whose visualization tools trace execution paths, capture state transitions and give runtime metrics. The docs also direct users to a tracing quickstart to see data flow through each step. However, the UI lives in the companion LangSmith product, and the evidence never says that every LLM call and tool invocation is captured individually. missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation trace capture, in-depth tracing setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the observability UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: Debugging with LangSmith — Gain deep visibility into complex agent behavior with visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide detailed runtime metrics.
Trace and compare these workflow patterns with LangSmith
